description: Provision an AWS Dynamodb Backup via the ACK dynamodb controller. Fields mirror the dynamodb.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 Backup spec.

backupName.description:
Specified name for the backup.

Regex Pattern: `^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$`

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

tableName.description:
The name of the table. You can also provide the Amazon Resource Name (ARN)
of the table in this parameter.

title: AWS Dynamodb Backup
